target_customer: Mid-size and growth-stage tech companies whose IT teams handle internal support requests (named customers include Gusto, Instacart, ThoughtSpot, Jobber, Retool)
problem: IT teams spend time provisioning software access and answering repeat questions. Risotto auto-solves tickets and access requests in Slack, Teams and email, with time-limited permissions and approvals.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI IT help desk
product_category: AI IT help desk and access management

founders.name: Aron Solberg
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

founders.name: Alex Confer
founders.background_notes: Led HelloSign IT through its acquisition by Dropbox per YC page.

founders.name: Chris Paul
founders.background_notes: About 25 years as an engineer per YC page.

investors: Angels including former Dropbox and HelloSign executives

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable agents that grant access across many SaaS tools, enforce permissions and integrate with Slack, Okta and ticketing systems need careful security engineering, but use standard LLM and API components.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integrations with identity and ticketing systems and SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance raise switching costs, but Moveworks, Atomicwork and others sell similar products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent ITSM vendors offer AI chat features; no acquisition of Risotto found as of the sources.

market_need_then: IT teams were overloaded with repetitive access and support tickets, and SOC 2 requires access reviews. Customers report Gusto auto-resolving about 55 to 60 percent of tickets (company and press claims).

branding.domain_note: Uses tryrisotto.com, a prefix variant rather than risotto.com.

identity.visual_style: Not described in the page text
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual and upbeat, tagline AI support. Built by IT, loved by everyone.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline Built by IT, loved by everyone

brand_strength.rationale: A playful food name and friendly tone are distinctive, but no press about the brand itself was found and searches for the name return recipes.

outcome_analysis: Risotto's founders came from HelloSign, Dropbox and Gusto IT and product roles, and the product won well-known customers such as Gusto, Instacart and Retool. A 10M USD seed led by Bonfire arrived in January 2026, long after the Winter 2024 batch, which suggests capital-light growth. Moveworks and ITSM incumbents are the main threat.
notes: The 10M seed in Jan 2026 is reported by Pulse 2 with matching dates and amounts in other outlets and CB Insights seen in search results. One older profile reports a 500K seed and 1M revenue in 2024, unverified so not recorded as a round; CB Insights shows 10.5M across five rounds, which implies other small rounds not itemized (funding coverage partial). The competitor search returned only 2025 to 2026 pages, so the list is empty.
